object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time duration window you extended for ${entitlementName} is extended for an additional ${extensionDuration}.

#if($activationUrl)

You may return to $__global.productName here to see your options for extending or deactivating this entitlement early.

#end

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Notifies the identity whose Just-In-Time activation window was extended that the active JIT window has been extended.
object.name: Just-In-Time Activation Extended
object.subject: Your Just-In-Time access for ${entitlementName} has been extended
